title: Bind an Engram session on its first gated prompt, not when its delegation is created
outcome: Turn-gate simplification Greg adopted 25 Sep (Engram::Opus relay, mailbox #200; assessment docs/features/turn-gate-assessment.md in the Engram worktree). Today TermAl binds at delegation creation: 642 of 913 bound sessions never asked for a turn. Binding lazily on the first gated prompt removes those binds and most of the rebind fan-out after a restart (see tm-56ga serial post-commit rebinding; tm-b8cw lazy bind after a released boot-recovery binding). Acceptance: no session_bind before the first gated prompt; the first gated prompt binds then evaluates; restart rebinds only sessions that had bound; existing binding-absence recovery (tm-cnsv) still holds. Engram side needs no change.
